text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's already the 3rd "Ramen Jamboree"...! 
We've really made a whole lot of ramen, 
haven't we!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right! So this time, even more so! I want 
to put everything I've learned to good use 
and really liven things up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But... how are we supposed to hype 
things up even more than this?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is an emergency! Everyone! Do you 
have a moment!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"As a result of hosting events up to this 
day—we've had an outpouring of requests 
from all over the country saying 'Please 
host one here too!' and 'Please do it 
again!'"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So, how about it? For the next Ramen 
Jamboree—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Regional, Central, it doesn't matter! 
Holding it at as many racetracks across 
the entire country as possible is—!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I call it— 'Super Ramen Jamboree: 
Zenith'!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Oooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Super, supreme...!! If so, then the ramen 
we serve must be supreme as well!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about this time, we make the 
ultimate cup of ramenâ packed with 
everything we've experienced so far!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that sounds awesome! The grand 
culmination! So basically, it's like a 
ramen with all the toppings!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
First, Fukushima! Traditional bowls! Next, 
Nagoya! Thick, rich soup!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Plus Kokura! Soft noodles! And Hokkaido! 
Top-notch toppings!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, Niigata. Served at top speed. 
—Behold. This is our ultimate ramen! Bam.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Bleurgh?! *burp*... Wh-What is this~...?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, it's hard to say, but... Those 
elements are clashing completely!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I want to eat ramen like wanko 
soba, but the thick broth sticking to the 
noodles refuses to allow it...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Because the noodles are soft, they cling 
to the soup... but they also break easily. 
Perhaps we should narrow down the 
ingredients...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I see. You're right. If we want to 
include the charms of every region, we 
need to rethink our approach...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Or maybe just add the core essence of 
it? I wonder if that would bring it all 
into harmony.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see, the core... the core, huh... Then, 
how about this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we visit each region once more 
to check? What ingredients should go in, 
region by region!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm the one who served the best 
ramen in Niigata. Please tell me what left 
an impression on you back then.

text_block_list.name: Rice Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"What left an impression? ...Your 
efficiency, I suppose. You delivered 
freshly boiled noodles in peak condition, 
so I ended up eating bowl after bowl!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Fumu... 'Skillful handling', is it?

text_block_list.name: Artisan
text_block_list.text:
I saw your bowl. ...You really studied 
ceramics seriously, didn't you? The 
finished piece clearly shows it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you so much! But that's 
really... taking things seriously was all 
I could do!

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
...The morning ramen was delicious. Your 
thoughtfulness really came through.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A caring heart... Could that be... 
useless little me's...?

text_block_list.name: Kokura Butcher
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chan! That ramen was super tasty! It 
used Kokura specialties too... It was just 
overflowing with local love! It was the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't you praising me a bit too 
much~!? Then again... yeah, hometown 
pride, huh...

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, it was all Fine's good 
nature. That's why so many people helped 
out, and how that delicious 'Fine Kingdom 
Ramen' came to be.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Popular support... Hehe♪ I'm so blessed to 
have met people who would say such things 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having revisited various regions, 
they gathered at the academy once again—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. Tell me. What kind of 
ramen do you want to eat?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll live up to everyone's expectations. 
This time for sure!
